featured_title: Is the Naples Housing Market Balanced Right Now? What the September 2026 Numbers Say
featured_excerpt: Naples inventory is down 17.3% from last year, sales are up 2.5%, and the median price is holding at $575,000. Here is what the September 2026 numbers mean for buyers and sellers heading into season.
others_caption: Also this week: Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues, Tidewater by Del Webb's occupancy rules, how to get a home removed from a Lee County flood zone, Naples school attendance zones, the cost of the guard at the gate at The Preserve at Corkscrew, and selling on Corkscrew Road ahead of the pipeline.
